CHAPITRE PREMIER : DISPOSITIONS
GÉNÉRALES

articles.heading: Icyo iri tegeko rigamije Iri tegeko rigenga Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda, «BNR» mu magambo ahinnye y’ururimi
articles.text: rw’Ikinyarwanda.

articles.heading: Isobanura Muri iri tegeko
articles.text:
(a) « amabwiriza » bivuga inyandiko
ishyirwaho na BNR hashingiwe ku
nshingano zayo, igamije gusobanura
kurushaho ibigomba kubahirizwa mu
gushyira mu bikorwa ibikubiye muri
iri tegeko cyangwa irindi tegeko;
(b) « amabwiriza yihariye » bivuga
inyandiko ishyirwaho na BNR
igaragaza ibisabwa gukorwa cyangwa
kudakorwa igenewe umuntu ku giti
cye cyangwa ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi;
(c) « amafaranga y’ingoboka » bivuga
umutungo w’amafaranga ubikiwe
kuzakoreshwa mu gihe kizaza, mu
rwego rwo kurengera ibikorwa
byabura ingengo y’imari kandi
byihutirwa, ukaba igisubizo ku biciro
bitunguranye kandi ugafatwa
nk’umutungo w’inyongera mu bihe
bisanzwe;
(d) « Guverineri » bivuga Guverineri wa
BNR;
(e) « Guverineri Wungirije » bivuga
Guverineri Wungirije wa BNR;
(f) « ikigo cy’imari » kirimo –
(i) banki;
(ii) ikigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira
amafaranga abitswa;
(iii) ikigo kiguriza kitakira
amafaranga ya rubanda;
(iv) ikigo cy’ubwishingizi;
(v) ikigo cy’ubwiteganyirize
bw’abakozi;
(vi) ikigega cy’ubwiteganyirize bwa
pansiyo butegetswe
n’ubw’ubushake;
(vii) ibiro by’ivunjisha;
(viii) utanga serivisi zo kwishyurana;
(ix) ushinzwe imikoreshereze
y’uburyo bwo kwishyurana;
(x) n’ikigo cy’imari kitagenzurwa
n’ikindi kigo hashingiwe ku
itegeko ryihariye.
(g) « ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi » bivuga
isosiyete y’ubucuruzi, koperative
cyangwa urwego rutari umuntu ku giti cye
bihabwa uburenganzira n’inshingano
imbere y’amategeko;
(h) « imirongo ngenderwaho » bivuga
inyandiko ishyirwaho na BNR, itanga
icyerekezo ku bikorwa biri mu nshingano
cyangwa mu bubasha bwayo;
(i) « intumwa ya BNR » bivuga ikigo
cy’imari gikorera mu Rwanda cyangwa
mu mahanga, gikora ibikorwa byihariye
mu izina rya BNR, hashingiwe ku
masezerano;
(j) « politiki rusange » bivuga politiki
z’imiyoborere hatarimo politiki
y’ifaranga;
(k) « uhagarariye BNR » bivuga ikigo
cy’imari gikorera mu mahanga kigirana
amasezerano y’ubufatanye mu
by’amabanki na BNR kugira ngo
kiyibikire amafaranga kandi gitange
serivisi z’imari mpuzamahanga mu izina
ryayo;
(l) « ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi utari
nshingwabikorwa » bivuga ugize Inama
y’Ubuyobozi uretse Guverineri na
Guverineri Wungirije;
(m)« utanga serivisi mu bwizerane no mu
masosiyete y’ubucuruzi » hakubiyemo
umuntu –
(i) ukora nk’umukozi ufasha abandi
gushinga ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi;
(ii) ukora nk’ugize inama y’ubutegetsi
cyangwa umunyamabanga
w’isosiyete y’ubucuruzi,
umufatanyabikorwa mu bufatanye
mu bucuruzi cyangwa umwanya
usa n’iyo mu bindi bigo bifite
ubuzimagatozi, cyangwa ufasha
undi muntu gukora nka bo;
(iii) ushakira isosiyete y’ubucuruzi,
ubufatanye mu bucuruzi cyangwa
ikindi kigo gifite ubuzimagatozi
cyangwa umuryango ushingiye ku
masezerano, ibiro byanditse,
aderesi y’ubucuruzi, aho gukorera,
aderesi yifashishwa mu kwakira no
kohereza ubutumwa cyangwa
aderesi y’ubuyobozi;
(iv) ukora nk’ucunga iby’abandi
w’umwuga mu kigega
cy’ubwizerane kizwi cyangwa
ukora umurimo umeze nka wo mu
muryango ushingiye ku
masezerano cyangwa ufasha undi
muntu kubikora;
(v) cyangwa ukora
nk’umunyamigabane
washyiriweho undi muntu cyangwa
ufasha undi muntu gukora nka we.

articles.heading: Imari shingiro (1) Imari shingiro ya BNR ni FRW 7.000.000.000 itangwa na Leta y’u Rwanda. Ntitangwaho ingwate kandi
articles.text:
ntishobora gufatirwa.
(2) Imari shingiro ya BNR ishobora
kongerwa n’amafaranga y’ingoboka,
Inama y’Ubuyobozi imaze
kubitangaho inama cyangwa
ikongerwa n’amafaranga y’inyongera
atangwa na Leta y’u Rwanda
bikemezwa n’Iteka rya Perezida.

articles.heading: Ubuzimagatozi, ubwigenge n’ubwisanzure (1) BNR ifite ubuzimagatozi, ubwigenge n’ubwisanzure mu byerekeye
articles.text:
imiyoborere, imicungire n’imari.
(2) BNR, abakozi bayo, intumwa zayo
n’abagize inzego zifata ibyemezo
ntibagengwa n’amabwiriza y’undi
muntu cyangwa ay’urundi rwego mu
gihe bakoresha ububasha bwabo
cyangwa buzuza inshingano zabo.
(3) BNR ntiyandikwa mu gitabo
cy’amasosiyete y’ubucuruzi kandi
ntirebwa n’amabwiriza agenga
ibaruramari rya Leta. Icyakora, BNR
ikurikiza amategeko asanzwe
y’ibaruramari ry’ubucuruzi kandi mu
mirimo yayo y’ubucuruzi ikorana
n’abandi igengwa n’amategeko
yerekeye ubucuruzi mu gihe
amategeko yihariye ayigenga
atanyuranya na yo.

articles.heading: Icyicaro gikuru cya BNR, amashami yayo, abayihagararira n’intumwa zayo (1) Icyicaro gikuru cya BNR giherereye
articles.text:
mu Mujyi wa Kigali. Gishobora
kwimurirwa ahandi mu Rwanda igihe
bibaye ngombwa, byemejwe n’iteka
rya Minisitiri w’Intebe.
(2) BNR ishobora gushinga ishami ryayo
aho ari ho hose mu Gihugu, byemejwe
n’Inama y’Ubuyobozi.
(3) BNR ishobora kugena intumwa yayo
cyangwa uyihagararira mu bikorwa
byayo.
UMUTWE WA II: INTEGO,
INSHINGANO N’UBUBASHA

articles.heading: Intego ya BNR Intego ya BNR ni ukubungabunga agaciro k’ifaranga no kubaka urwego rw’imari rutajegajega, bituma habaho iterambere
articles.text: rirambye kandi ridaheza.

articles.heading: Inshingano za BNR BNR ifite inshingano zikurikira
articles.text:
(a) kugena no gushyira mu bikorwa
politiki y’ifaranga;
(b) gutunganya no kugenzura isoko
ry’ivunjisha;
(c) kugenzura ibigo by’imari;
(d) kugenzura abatanga serivisi mu
bwizerane no mu masosiyete
y’ubucuruzi;
(e) kugenzura no gukurikirana uburyo
bwo kwishyurana;
(f) gusesengura ukutajegajega k’urwego
rw’imari hagamijwe gushyigikira
izamuka n’iterambere by’ubukungu;
(g) gutegura, gushyiraho no gushyira mu
bikorwa politiki z’uburyo
bw’ihwanyabwishyu n’uburyo
bw’imyishyuranire bukora neza;
(h) gucunga ifaranga;
(i) kubika no gucunga amadovize
y’Igihugu;
(j) kuba Umubitsi wa Leta;
(k) gukusanya, kwegeranya, gutangaza
imibare y’ibarura yerekeye ifaranga
n’imari;
(l) gukurikirana no guteza imbere
imikorere y’ibigo by’imari kugira ngo
byubahirize amategeko abigenga;
(m)gushyiraho politiki zirinda
uburenganzira n’inyungu
by’abakiriya, ababitsa n’abandi bafite
inyungu iyo ari yo yose itari ukubitsa
mu bigo by’imari hitabwa ku bikenewe
n’ibigo by’imari kugira ngo ihiganwa
rikorwe neza ku isoko no gukora
ibishoboka byose birinda ibyateza
ingorane zishobora kubaho;
(n) gutanga ibitekerezo, ibyibwirije
cyangwa ibisabwe na Leta, ku miterere
y’imari imbere mu Gihugu no
kugaragaza ingamba zikwiye.
Ibitekerezo bya BNR ku miterere
y’ifaranga, uburyo bwo guhabwa
inguzanyo no ku bukungu muri
rusange, bisabwa by’umwihariko mu
gihe Leta ishaka gufata icyemezo
cyerekeranye n’ifaranga cyangwa
n’imari;
(o) gufata ingamba zo gucunga no
gukemura ibibazo byatera ihungabana
ry’imari, keretse igihe izo nshingano
zagenewe ikindi kigo by’umwihariko,
hashingiwe ku mategeko yihariye;
(p) gutangariza rubanda, mu buryo
bw’ingarukagihe, ingamba zerekeye
ukudahungabana kw’ifaranga,
ukutajegajega k’urwego rw’imari
n’uburyo bwo kuzishyira mu bikorwa;
(q) gukora indi nshingano ifitanye isano,
cyangwa ikomoka ku mirimo yayo,
iteganywa n’iri tegeko cyangwa
ishobora guteganywa n’andi
mategeko.

articles.heading: Ububasha bwa BNR BNR ifite ububasha bukurikira
articles.text:
(a) gushyiraho amabwiriza, amabwiriza
yihariye cyangwa imirongo
ngenderwaho;
(b) gutanga, guhagarika by’agateganyo no
gukuraho impushya cyangwa
uburenganzira bijyanye n’inshingano
zayo;
(c) gutanga ibihano byo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi bijyanye n’inshingano
zayo;
(d) gushinga ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi
cyangwa kwegukana imigabane muri
sosiyete y’ubucuruzi y’imbere mu
Gihugu, iyo mu mahanga cyangwa
mpuzamahanga, igihe Inama
y’Ubuyobozi ibona ari ngombwa,
hagamijwe guhanga ibishya mu rwego
rw’imari, guhugura abakozi bayo
cyangwa ibigo igenzura n’imibereho
myiza y’abakozi bayo;
(e) gufata ibyemezo ku bibazo biri mu
nshingano zayo nk’uko biteganywa
n’iri tegeko n’andi mategeko yihariye.
UMUTWE WA III: IMITUNGANYIRIZE
Icyiciro cya mbere: Inzego z’ubuyobozi

articles.heading: Inzego z’ubuyobozi za BNR Inzego z’ubuyobozi za BNR ni – (a) Inama y’Ubuyobozi; (b) n’Ubuyobozi
articles.text: Akiciro ka mbere: Inama y’Ubuyobozi

articles.heading: Abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi, ishyirwaho na manda byabo (1) Inama y’Ubuyobozi igizwe n’abantu 11 bakurikira
articles.text:
(a) Guverineri;
(b) Guverineri Wungirije;
(c) abandi bantu icyenda bashyirwaho
kandi bakavanwaho n’Iteka rya
Perezida, batoranywa hakurikijwe
ubushobozi n’ubunararibonye mu
byerekeranye n’ifaranga, imari,
ubukungu, icungamari, imicungire
y’ibyateza ingorane, amategeko,
ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho
cyangwa mu zindi nzego zirebana
n’imirimo ya BNR.
(2) Abakozi ba Leta ntibashobora kurenga
30% by’abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi
hatabariwemo Guverineri, Guverineri
Wungirije n’uturuka mu rwego
rw’amashuri makuru cyangwa mu
bigo by’ubushakashatsi.
(3) Guverineri ni we Muyobozi w’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi akungirizwa na
Guverineri Wungirije, keretse iyo
biteganywa ukundi n’urwego
rubashyiraho.
(4) Abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi bagira
manda y’imyaka ine ishobora
kongerwa inshuro imwe, uretse
Guverineri na Guverineri Wungirije.
(5) Abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi
bashyirwaho mu bihe bitandukanye
kugira ngo imirimo y’ubuyobozi bwa
BNR ikomeze gukorwa.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa kugira ngo umuntu abe ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi Kugira ngo umuntu abe mu bagize Inama
Inshingano z’Inama y’Ubuyobozi (1) Inama y’Ubuyobozi ishyiraho politiki rusange ya BNR ikanakurikirana
articles.text:
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryayo.
(2) By’umwihariko, Inama y’Ubuyobozi
ifite inshingano zikurikira:
(a) gushyiraho politiki zijyanye no
gutunganya imirimo ya BNR no
kwemeza imiterere y’inzego
z’imirimo yayo;
(b) gusuzuma no kwemeza
ishyirwaho, ikorwa cyangwa
ikurwaho ry’ubwoko bw’inoti,
ubw’ibiceri cyangwa ubundi buryo
bw’amafaranga n’ibibiranga
ikabyoherereza urwego rubifitiye
ububasha kugira ngo byemezwe;
(c) kugena imiterere y’akazi ka
Guverineri na Guverineri
Wungirije bidateganywa n’iri
tegeko;
(d) kwemeza gahunda y’ibikorwa
n’ingengo y’imari bya buri mwaka
bya BNR n’impinduka zabyo igihe
bibaye ngombwa;
(e) gushyiraho umugenzuzi wigenga
wa BNR;
(f) kwemeza raporo z’imari zateguwe
n’umugenzuzi wigenga no kugena
uko inyungu zisaranganywa;
(g) kwemeza raporo y’ibikorwa ya
buri mwaka Guverineri ageza kuri
Perezida wa Repubulika no ku
Nteko Ishinga Amategeko;
(h) gushyiraho no kwemeza inyandiko
ikubiyemo amahame
n’amabwiriza ngengamikorere
by’Inama y’Ubuyobozi n’andi
mabwiriza agenga imitunganyirize
y’imirimo yayo;
(i) gutanga inama ku kongera imari
shingiro ya BNR hifashishijwe
amafaranga y’ingoboka mu gihe
bibaye ngombwa.

articles.heading: Ububasha bw’Inama y’Ubuyobozi (1) Inama y’Ubuyobozi ifite ububasha bukurikira
articles.text:
(a) kugenzura ishyirwa mu bikorwa
rya politiki rusange n’imicungire
bya BNR;
(b) kwemeza amabwiriza
n’amabwiriza yihariye;
(c) gufata icyemezo kirebana
n’ubugenzuzi bw’ibigo by’imari
ishingiye ku mategeko;
(d) kwemeza amategeko
ngengamikorere na politiki bya
BNR;
(e) kwemeza amategeko
ngengamikorere yihariye agenga
uburyo bwo gushaka abakozi ba
BNR, kubashyira mu myanya,
imicungire n’iyirukanwa byabo,
imishahara yabo n’ibindi
bagenerwa;
(f) kwemeza amabwiriza yihariye
agenga itangwa ry’amasoko ya
BNR;
A
(g) kwemeza inyandiko ikubiyemo
amahame n’amabwiriza
ngengamikorere by’ubugenzuzi
bwite hubahirizwa amahame
mpuzamahanga;
(h) gushyiraho amashami ya BNR no
kugena aho akorera;
(i) gushyiraho Komite z’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi. Icyakora,
Guverineri cyangwa Guverineri
Wungirije ntashobora kuba umwe
mu bagize Komite z’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi;
(j) kugena umushahara n’ibindi
bigenerwa Guverineri na
Guverineri Wungirije mu gihe bari
mu kazi na nyuma yo kurangiza
manda yabo, imaze kugisha inama
urwego rubashyiraho;
(k) gushyiraho abagize Komite
zihariye batari abakozi ba BNR no
kugena ibyo bagenerwa;
(l) gufata icyemezo ku byerekeranye
no kwakira, gutanga no kugurisha
umutungo wa BNR no ku
mikoreshereze y’imari bwite yayo;
(m)gufata icyemezo ku kindi kibazo
cyerekeranye n’intego ya BNR iri
tegeko cyangwa irindi tegeko
ritageneye urundi rwego rwa BNR.
(2) Inama y’Ubuyobozi ishobora guha
Guverineri bumwe mu bubasha
bwayo, harimo by’umwihariko ubwo
gushyiraho amabwiriza cyangwa
amabwiriza yihariye no gufata
ibyemezo nk’uko biteganyijwe mu
gika cya (1)(c), uretse ububasha bwayo
bwo kugenzura ishyirwa mu bikorwa
rya politiki rusange n’imicungire bya
BNR.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’Umuyobozi w’Inama y’Ubuyobozi Umuyobozi w’Inama y’Ubuyobozi afite inshingano zikurikira
articles.text:
(a) gutumiza no kuyobora inama y’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi no guhuza ibikorwa
byayo;
(b) gukurikirana ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry’ibyemezo by’Inama y’Ubuyobozi;
(c) gukora indi nshingano yahabwa
n’Inama y’Ubuyobozi ifite aho ihuriye
n’inshingano zayo.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’Umuyobozi Wungirije w’Inama y’Ubuyobozi Umuyobozi Wungirije w’Inama y’Ubuyobozi
articles.text:
afite inshingano zikurikira:
(a) kunganira Umuyobozi w’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi no kumusimbura
igihe adahari;
(b) gukora indi nshingano yahabwa
n’Inama y’Ubuyobozi ifite aho
ihuriye n’inshingano zayo.

articles.heading: Ibitabangikanywa no kuba mu Nama y’Ubuyobozi (1) Imirimo y’abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi ya BNR ntibangikanywa
articles.text:
no kuba ugize Inteko Ishinga
Amategeko cyangwa ugize
Guverinoma n’uburyo ubwo ari bwo
bwose bwo kugira uruhare, haba
uruhemberwa cyangwa
urudahemberwa mu kigo kigenzurwa
na BNR.
(2) Ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi
ntiyemerewe kuba umukozi wa BNR,
uretse Guverineri na Guverineri
Wungirije.
(3) Ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi,
ntiyemerewe gupiganira amasoko
atangwa na BNR, haba ku giti cye
cyangwa isosiyete y’ubucuruzi
afitemo imigabane.

articles.heading: Itumizwa n’iterana by’inama y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi (1) Inama y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi isanzwe iterana rimwe mu
articles.text:
gihembwe. Itumizwa kandi
ikayoborwa n’Umuyobozi
w’Inama y’Ubuyobozi cyangwa
Umuyobozi Wungirije iyo
Umuyobozi w’Inama y’Ubuyobozi
adahari.
(2) Ubutumire bw’inama y’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi bukorwa mu
nyandiko ishyikirizwa abagize
A
m
Inama y’Ubuyobozi hasigaye
nibura iminsi icumi y’akazi mbere
y’uko inama iterana.
(3) Inama y’Ubuyobozi ishobora
guterana mu nama idasanzwe
bisabwe n’Umuyobozi wayo
cyangwa ku busabe bwa bibiri bya
gatatu by’abayigize. Iyo nama
isuzuma gusa ibiri ku murongo
w’ibyigwa.
(4) Umubare wa ngombwa kugira ngo
inama y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi
iterane ni bibiri bya gatatu
by’abayigize. Icyakora, iyo inama
y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi itumijwe
ubwa kabiri umubare wa ngombwa
ntuboneke iterana iyo hari nibura
kimwe cya kabiri cy’abagize
Inama y’Ubuyobozi.

articles.heading: Itumira mu nama y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi ry’undi muntu (1) Inama y’Ubuyobozi ishobora gutumira mu nama yayo undi muntu ibona ko
articles.text:
ashobora kuyungura inama ku ngingo
runaka ifite ku murongo w’ibyigwa.
(2) Uwatumiwe ntiyemerewe gutora no
gukurikirana isuzumwa ry’izindi
ngingo ziri ku murongo w’ibyigwa.
(3) Uwatumiwe mu nama y’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi agomba kugira ibanga
ry’ibyo yamenyeye muri iyo nama.

articles.heading: Ifatwa ry’ibyemezo n’inyandikomvugo by’inama y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi (1) Inama y’Ubuyobozi ifata
articles.text:
ibyemezo mu bwumvikane
busesuye. Iyo ubwumvikane
butabashije kuboneka, ibyemezo
bifatwa ku bwiganze bw’amajwi
y’abitabiriye inama. Iyo amajwi
angana, ijwi ry’umuyobozi
w’inama ni ryo rikemura impaka.
(2) Inyandikomvugo y’inama y’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi ishyirwaho umukono
n’abitabiriye inama bose.
(3) Kopi y’ibyemezo by’inama
y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi
yohererezwa Minisitiri ufite imari
mu nshingano inama ikirangira.
(4) Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n’iri
tegeko, inyandiko ikubiyemo
amahame n’amabwiriza
ngengamikorere by’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi igena uko
inyandikomvugo z’inama y’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi zifatwa n’ibindi
byerekeye imigendekere y’inama
zayo.

articles.heading: Inyungu bwite ku ngingo isuzumwa (1) Iyo ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi afite inyungu bwite iziguye cyangwa
articles.text:
itaziguye ku ngingo isuzumwa, ahita
amenyesha Inama y’Ubuyobozi aho
inyungu ye ishingiye.
(2) Ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi ufite
inyungu bwite ku ngingo isuzumwa
ntiyitabira inama isuzuma iyo ngingo.

articles.heading: Insimburamubyizi n’ibindi bigenerwa ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi witabiriye inama Iteka rya Perezida rigena insimburamubyizi
articles.text:
n’ibindi bigenerwa ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi
witabiriye inama y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi kandi
ntibishobora kugabanywa mu gihe cya manda
ye.

articles.heading: Impamvu zituma ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi ava muri uwo mwanya n’uko asimburwa (1) Ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi ava muri
articles.text:
uwo mwanya iyo –
(a) manda irangiye;
(b) atacyujuje ibyashingiweho
ashyirwa muri uwo mwanya;
(c) atagishoboye gukora imirimo ye
kubera ubumuga bw’umubiri
cyangwa ubwo mu mutwe,
byemejwe n’umuganga wemewe
na Leta;
(d) yeguye;
(e) yirukanywe;
(f) cyangwa apfuye.
(2) Umuyobozi w’Inama y’Ubuyobozi
amenyesha mu nyandiko urwego
rushyiraho ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi
ko hari ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi
ugiye kurangiza manda hasigaye
nibura iminsi 90 ngo manda irangire.
Iyo hari ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi
utakiri muri uwo mwanya kubera
impamvu ziteganywa mu gika cya
(1)(c) na (f), Umuyobozi w’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi abimenyesha mu gihe
cy’iminsi irindwi ibarwa uhereye ku
munsi yamenyeyeho iyo mpamvu.
(3) Iyo ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi
atakiyirimo, urwego rubifitiye
ububasha rushyiraho umusimbura mu
gihe cy’iminsi 90 ibarwa uhereye ku
munsi yayiviriyemo.

articles.heading: Komite y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi ishinzwe ubugenzuzi (1) Komite zishyirwaho n’Inama y’Ubuyobozi ziteganywa mu ngingo
articles.text:
ya 13(1)(i) zirimo Komite y’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi ishinzwe ubugenzuzi.
(2) Komite y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi
ishinzwe ubugenzuzi ikora imirimo
yayo hakurikijwe inyandiko
ikubiyemo amahame n’amabwiriza
ngengamikorere yayo.
(3) Abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi batari
nshingwabikorwa b’abakozi ba Leta
bashobora kujya muri Komite y’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi ishinzwe ubugenzuzi
bagatanga ubujyanama gusa. Icyakora,
abakozi ba Leta bagize Komite
y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi ishinzwe
ubugenzuzi bakomoka mu rwego
rw’amashuri makuru cyangwa mu
bigo by’ubushakashatsi bafite
uburenganzira bwo gutora.
Akiciro ka 2: Ubuyobozi

articles.heading: Abagize Ubuyobozi, ishyirwaho n’ivanwa mu mirimo byabo (1) Ubuyobozi bwa BNR bugizwe na Guverineri na Guverineri Wungirije
articles.text:
bashyirwaho kandi bakavanwa mu
mirimo n’iteka rya Perezida.
(2) Guverineri na Guverineri Wungirije
bashyirwaho mu gihe kitarenze iminsi
90 ibarwa uhereye ku munsi umwanya
w’umurimo udafite uwurimo.
Ishyirwaho ryabo ryemezwa na Sena.

articles.heading: Manda y’abagize Ubuyobozi
Inshingano za Guverineri (1) Guverineri afite inshingano zikurikira
articles.text:
(a) guhagararira BNR imbere
y’amategeko;
(b) kuyobora no guhuza ibikorwa bya
BNR;
(c) gushyira umukono ku masezerano
yose akorwa na BNR, raporo
z’umwaka, iz’uko umutungo
uhagaze, raporo igaragaza
ibyinjiye byose n’izindi raporo
z’imari, inzandiko n’izindi
nyandiko za BNR;
(d) gushyira umukono ku noti;
(e) kugena ibisabwa kuri buri mwanya
w’umurimo muri BNR;
(f) gushaka, gushyira mu mwanya,
gucunga no gusezerera abakozi ba
BNR hashingiwe ku biteganywa
n’amategeko ngengamikorere
yihariye agenga abakozi ba BNR;
(g) gushyiraho uburyo bw’imikorere,
ibigomba kubahirizwa
n’amabwiriza y’akazi abona ko ari
ngombwa mu micungire myiza ya
BNR;
(h) gushyiraho imirongo
ngenderwaho;
(i) gucunga no gushyira mu bikorwa
ingengo y’imari yemejwe ya BNR;
(j) kwemeza intumwa ya BNR
cyangwa uhagarariye BNR;
(k) gushyikiriza Inama y’Ubuyobozi
gahunda y’ibikorwa n’umushinga
w’ingengo y’imari bya buri
mwaka;
(l) gukora indi nshingano yahabwa
n’Inama y’Ubuyobozi ifite aho
ihuriye n’inshingano za BNR.
(2) Undi mukozi wa BNR ashobora
gukora inshingano ziteganywa muri iyi
ngingo, uretse iyo gushyira umukono
ku noti, abiherewe ububasha na
Guverineri.
(3) Guverineri ashobora gukorana
n’inzego zifite inshingano zo
kureberera inzego za Leta mu gihe
ashyira mu bikorwa inshingano
ziteganywa mu gika cya (1)(f).

articles.heading: Inshingano za Guverineri Wungirije Guverineri Wungirije afite inshingano zikurikira
Ibitabangikanywa n’umurimo wa Guverineri n’uwa Guverineri Wungirije Guverineri na Guverineri Wungirije
articles.text:
ntibashobora kubangikanya umurimo wabo
n’undi murimo usaba gukorwa ku buryo
buhoraho.

articles.heading: Amasezerano y’imyenda Guverineri na Guverineri Wungirije badashyiraho umukono Guverineri na Guverineri Wungirije
articles.text:
ntibemerewe gushyira umukono ku
masezerano ashobora gufatwa
nk’ubwishingizi bw’imyenda BNR iha
amabanki y’ubucuruzi.

articles.heading: Impamvu zituma Guverineri cyangwa Guverineri Wungirije ava ku mwanya w’umurimo Guverineri cyangwa Guverineri Wungirije ava
Abagize Komite ishinzwe Politiki y’Ifaranga, ishyirwaho na manda byabo (1) Komite ishinzwe Politiki y’Ifaranga
articles.text:
igizwe n’abantu icyenda bakurikira:
(a) Guverineri, ari na we muyobozi
wayo;

(b) Guverineri Wungirije, ari na we
Muyobozi wungirije;
(c) abakozi bakuru babiri ba BNR
bashyirwaho na Guverineri,
harimo –
(i) umukozi ufite inshingano zo
ku rwego rwo hejuru mu
birebana n’isesengura rya
politiki y’ifaranga;
(ii) n’umukozi ufite inshingano
zo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu
birebana n’ibikorwa bya
politiki y’ifaranga.
(d) abandi bakozi ba BNR
bashyirwaho na Guverineri;
(e) abandi bagize Komite ishinzwe
Politiki y’Ifaranga batari abakozi
ba BNR bashyirwaho n’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi hashingiwe ku
bumenyi bwabo, ubunararibonye
n’ubuhanga bafite mu bijyanye
n’inshingano za Komite ishinzwe
Politiki y’Ifaranga.
(2) Abagize Komite ishinzwe Politiki
y’Ifaranga bashyirwaho n’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi bavugwa mu gika cya (1)(e)
bagira manda y’imyaka ine ishobora
kongerwa inshuro imwe.

articles.heading: Inshingano ya Komite ishinzwe Politiki y’Ifaranga Komite ishinzwe Politiki y’Ifaranga ifite
articles.text:
inshingano yo gushyiraho Politiki y’Ifaranga
muri BNR.

articles.heading: Inama ya Komite ishinzwe Politiki y’Ifaranga, ifatwa ry’ibyemezo n’inyandikomvugo (1) Inama ya Komite ishinzwe Politiki
articles.text:
y’Ifaranga iterana rimwe mu
gihembwe n’igihe bibaye ngombwa.
Inama itumizwa kandi ikayoborwa
n’Umuyobozi cyangwa Umuyobozi
Wungirije, iyo Umuyobozi adahari.
(2) Umubare wa ngombwa kugira ngo
inama ya Komite ishinzwe Politiki
y’Ifaranga iterane ni bibiri bya gatatu
by’abayigize.
(3) Komite ishinzwe Politiki y’Ifaranga
ifata ibyemezo ku bwumvikane
busesuye. Iyo ubwumvikane
butabonetse, ibyemezo bifatwa ku
bwiganze bw’amajwi y’abitabiriye
inama hatarimo abagize Komite batari
nshingwabikorwa b’abakozi ba Leta,
keretse abakomoka mu rwego
rw’amashuri makuru cyangwa mu
bigo by’ubushakashatsi. Iyo amajwi
angana, ijwi ry’umuyobozi w’inama ni
ryo rikemura impaka.
(4) Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n’iri
tegeko, amabwiriza ngengamikorere
ya Komite ishinzwe Politiki y’Ifaranga
agena uko inyandikomvugo z’inama
zifatwa n’ibindi byerekeye
imigendekere y’inama zayo.

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’iby’ingenzi muri Politiki y’Ifaranga Nyuma ya buri nama ya Komite ishinzwe Politiki y’Ifaranga, BNR itangaza mu gihe
articles.text:
gikwiye, iby’ingenzi muri Politiki y’Ifaranga
igomba gushyira mu bikorwa.
Akiciro ka 2: Komite ishinzwe
ukutajegajega k’Urwego rw’Imari

articles.heading: Abagize Komite ishinzwe ukutajegajega k’Urwego rw’Imari, ishyirwaho na manda byabo (1) Komite ishinzwe ukutajegajega
articles.text:
k’Urwego rw’Imari igizwe n’abantu
11 bakurikira:
(a) Guverineri, ari na we Muyobozi
wayo;
(b) Guverineri Wungirije, ari na we
Muyobozi wungirije;
(c) abakozi bo ku rwego rwo hejuru
batatu ba BNR bashyirwaho na
Guverineri, harimo –
(i) umukozi umwe ufite
inshingano zo ku rwego
rwo hejuru mu birebana
n’ukutajegajega k’urwego
rw’imari;
(ii) umukozi umwe ufite
inshingano zo ku rwego
rwo hejuru mu birebana
n’isesengura rya Politiki
y’Ifaranga;
(iii) umukozi umwe ufite
inshingano zo ku rwego
rwo hejuru mu birebana
n’ibikorwa bya Politiki
y’Ifaranga;
(d) abandi bakozi ba BNR
bashyirwaho na Guverineri, bafite
ubumenyi, uburambe n’ubuzobere
mu birebana n’inshingano za
Komite;
(e) abandi batari abakozi ba BNR,
bashyirwaho n’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi hashingiwe ku
bumenyi bwabo, ubunararibonye
n’ubuhanga bafite mu bijyanye
n’inshingano za Komite.
(2) Abagize Komite ishinzwe
ukutajegajega k’Urwego rw’Imari
bashyirwaho n’Inama y’Ubuyobozi
bavugwa mu gika cya (1)(e) bagira
manda y’imyaka ine ishobora
kongerwa inshuro imwe.

articles.heading: Inshingano za Komite ishinzwe ukutajegajega k’Urwego rw’Imari Komite ishinzwe ukutajegajega k’Urwego
articles.text:
rw’Imari ifite inshingano zikurikira:
(a) gusuzuma buri gihe no gukora ku
buryo urwego rw’imari ruba ruhamye
kandi rutajegajega;
(b) guteza imbere ukutajegajega k’urwego
rw’imari mu Rwanda, hakorwa
isesengura ryarwo ku buryo buhoraho
kandi hitawe ku buryo rukoramo;
(c) gutahura, gukurikirana no
kumenyekanisha ibyateza ingorane
zirebana n’urwego rw’imari kandi
igafata ingamba zikwiye zo gukumira,
kugabanya no koroshya ibyateza
ingorane.

articles.heading: Inama ya Komite ishinzwe ukutajegajega k’Urwego rw’Imari, ifatwa ry’ibyemezo n’inyandikomvugo
articles.text:
(1) Inama ya Komite ishinzwe
ukutajegajega k’Urwego rw’Imari
iterana rimwe mu gihembwe n’igihe
bibaye ngombwa. Itumizwa kandi
ikayoborwa n’Umuyobozi wayo
cyangwa n’Umuyobozi wungirije, iyo
Umuyobozi adahari.
(2) Umubare wa ngombwa kugira ngo
inama ya Komite ishinzwe
ukutajegajega k’Urwego rw’Imari
iterane ni bibiri bya gatatu
by’abayigize.
(3) Komite ishinzwe ukutajegajega
k’Urwego rw’Imari ifata ibyemezo ku
bwumvikane busesuye bw’abitabiriye
inama. Iyo ubwumvikane busesuye
butabonetse, ibyemezo bifatwa ku
bwiganze bw’amajwi y’abitabiriye
inama, hatabariwemo abagize Komite
batari Nshingwabikorwa b’abakozi ba
Leta, keretse abakomoka mu rwego
rw’amashuri makuru cyangwa mu
bigo by’ubushakashatsi. Iyo
ubwiganze bw’amajwi butabonetse,
ijwi ry’umuyobozi w’inama ni ryo
rikemura impaka.
(4) Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n’iri
tegeko, amabwiriza ngengamikorere
ya Komite ishinzwe ukutajegajega
k’Urwego rw’Imari agena uko
inyandikomvugo z’inama zifatwa
n’ibindi byerekeye imigendekere
y’inama zayo.

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’iby’ingenzi ku kutajegajega k’urwego rw’imari Nyuma ya buri nama ya Komite ishinzwe
articles.text:
ukutajegajega k’Urwego rw’Imari, BNR
itangaza mu gihe gikwiye, iby’ingenzi ku
kutajegajega k’urwego rw’imari.
UMUTWE WA IV: IMICUNGIRE
Y’IFARANGA
Icyiciro cya mbere: Imicungire y’ifaranga
ry’Igihugu

articles.heading: Amafaranga yemewe mu kwishyurana muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda (1) Urugero fatizo rw’amafaranga ya
articles.text:
Repubulika y’u Rwanda ni ifaranga
ry’u Rwanda, «FRW» mu magambo
ahinnye, mu ngingo zikurikira ryitwa «
ifaranga ».
(2) Ifaranga riri mu buryo bw’inoti,
ubw’ibiceri cyangwa ubundi buryo
bw’amafaranga bwemejwe n’urwego
rushyiraho ifaranga.
(3) Iteka rya Perezida rishyiraho inoti,
ibiceri cyangwa ubundi buryo
bw’amafaranga bufite agaciro mu
kwishyurana muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda kandi rikagena ibibiranga.
(4) Inoti iba iriho umukono wa Guverineri
n’uwa Guverineri Wungirije.
(5) Inoti, ibiceri cyangwa ubundi buryo
bw’amafaranga bifite agaciro mu
kwishyurana muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda bikomeza kugira agaciro
kugeza igihe bihinduriwe.
(6) Amasezerano ashingiye ku mafaranga
akorewe muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda
afatwa nk’aho yakozwe mu mafaranga
y’u Rwanda kandi yubahirizwa muri
ayo mafaranga gusa, keretse mu gihe
hari andi mategeko abiteganya ukundi.

articles.heading: Agaciro k’ifaranga Agaciro k’ifaranga mu bijyanye n’ivunjisha kagenwa hakurikijwe ingamba za Politiki
articles.text:
y’Ifaranga zashyizweho na BNR. Icyakora,
mu bihe bidasanzwe bishobora guteza
impinduka zikabije ku ifaranga, BNR igena
igipimo cy’ivunjisha ry’ifaranga mu gihe
kizwi.

articles.heading: Gucunga ifaranga
Umubare ntarengwa mu guhererekanya inoti n’ibiceri (1) Guhererekanya inoti ntibigira umubare
articles.text:
w’inoti ntarengwa.
(2) Ububasha bwo kwishyurana mu biceri
buhagararira kuri buri bwoko
bw’ibiceri, ku nshuro 100 agaciro
kanditse kuri buri bwoko bw’ibiceri,
keretse iyo uwishyurwa yemeye
kwakira umubare w’ibiceri urengaho.
Icyakora, nta mubare ntarengwa mu
iyakirwa ryabyo ubaho kuri BNR, ku
isanduku ya Leta cyangwa ku kigo
cy’imari cyakira amafaranga ya
rubanda.

articles.heading: Ikurwaho ry’inoti, ibiceri cyangwa ubundi buryo bw’amafaranga n’uko ritangazwa (1) BNR itanga inama ijyanye no
articles.text:
gukuraho inoti, ibiceri cyangwa
ubundi buryo bw’amafaranga
byakoreshwaga.
(2) Iteka rya Perezida rikuraho inoti,
ibiceri cyangwa ubundi buryo
bw’amafaranga byakoreshwaga
rikanagena igihe izo noti, ibiceri
cyangwa ubundi buryo bw’amafaranga
bizaba bitagifite agaciro.
(3) Ikurwaho ry’inoti, ibiceri cyangwa
ubundi buryo bw’amafaranga
byakoreshwaga bitangarizwa rubanda
binyujijwe nibura mu
bitangazamakuru bibiri bikurikirwa na
benshi mu Gihugu. Icyakora, iryo
menyekanisha rishobora
kutubahirizwa mu bihe bidasanzwe.
(4) Itangazwa rivugwa mu gika cya (3)
ryerekana uburyo ivunjisha ry’inoti,
ibiceri cyangwa ubundi buryo
bw’amafaranga bitagikoreshwa
rizakorwa. Iyo umunsi ntarengwa
wagenwe mu itangazo urenze, BNR
ifata icyemezo ku noti, ibiceri cyangwa
ubundi buryo bw’amafaranga
bayizaniye kuvunja nyuma y’uwo
munsi.
Icyiciro cya 2: Imicungire y’amadovize

articles.heading: Ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi byemewe Mu rwego rwo guhora yizigamye amadovize no kuyacunga, BNR ishobora –
articles.text:
(a) kugura, kugurisha, kubika, kuguriza no
kuguza amadovize mu buryo arimo
bwose;
(b) gukora ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi
n’amabanki y’ubucuruzi yo mu
mahanga, abafatanyabikorwa
mpuzamahanga babyemerewe ndetse
n’ibindi bigo by’imari cyangwa
ibigega by’imari;
(c) gukora imirimo y’igura n’igurisha
ikoresheje zahabu, mu nyungu zayo
bwite cyangwa mu nyungu z’abandi
bantu;
(d) kugura, kugurisha cyangwa kubika
zahabu y’ifaranga, zahabu
itunganyijwe ku buryo ishyirwa mu
bubiko cyangwa andi mabuye
y’agaciro;
(e) gushora amadovize mu bwoko ubwo
ari bwo bwose bw’umutungo wemewe
gushorwamo, mu ifaranga ryemewe
n’urwego rwemewe, nk’uko
biteganywa na politiki yayo
y’ishoramari n’imirongo ngenderwaho
bihuye n’iri tegeko;
(f) gufungura konti iyo ari yo yose no
kubika amadovize mu
bafatanyabikorwa bemewe bo mu
mahanga cyangwa bo mu Gihugu;
(g) no gukora ibikorwa byo gutera
inkunga ubucuruzi no gutanga
cyangwa kwakira ingwate zitanzwe
mu madovize.

articles.heading: Imitunganyirize y’isoko ry’ivunjisha BNR ishinzwe imitunganyirize n’imicungire y’isoko ry’ivunjisha. Ishyiraho amabwiriza
articles.text:
n’amabwiriza yihariye agenga iryo soko,
ikanakurikirana ko yubahirizwa.

articles.heading: Imicungire y’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’agaciro k’ifaranga (1) Inyungu n’ibihombo bikomoka ku
articles.text:
bikorwa by’ivunjisha byandikwa mu
nyandiko y’inyungu n’igihombo ya
BNR.
(2) Inyungu n’ibihombo bitaragaragara
bituruka ku ishyirwaho ry’agaciro
gashya k’umutungo w’amadovize
cyangwa imyenda BNR ifitiye
amahanga bigaragara mu ifoto
y’umutungo wa BNR kubera
impinduka zo mu buryo bw’ivunjisha
cyangwa ihindagurika ry’agaciro
k’ifaranga, byandikwa muri konti
yihariye yitwa «Konti
y’imihindagurikire y’amadovize».
(3) BNR ibarura inyungu cyangwa
igihombo byaturutse ku ishyirwaho
ry’agaciro gashya k’umutungo
cyangwa imyenda, hakurikijwe
ibipimo mpuzamahanga ngenderwaho
mu gutegura raporo z’imari.
Icyiciro cya 3: Isoko ry’amafaranga

articles.heading: Imitunganyirize y’isoko ry’amafaranga (1) BNR ishyiraho amabwiriza n’amabwiriza yihariye byerekeye
articles.text:
imitunganyirize n’imikorere by’isoko
ry’amafaranga ikanashyira
ahagaragara ibigo byemerewe
gukorera kuri iryo soko n’ibyemerewe
gucururizwaho.
(2) BNR yita ku migendekere myiza
y’imirimo amabanki akorana hagati
yayo ku isoko ry’amafaranga
ikanagenzura ibikorwa byayo.

articles.heading: Ibikorwa bya BNR ku isoko ry’amafaranga (1) BNR ishobora kugira uruhare ku isoko ry’amafaranga ku mpamvu zo
articles.text:
kuguriza, kuguza cyangwa kugura no
kugurisha umutungo mvunjwafaranga
ushobora kongera kugurishwa binyuze
mu masezerano yo kongera kugura
inyandiko z’agaciro zagurishijwe,
kugwatiriza inyandiko z’agaciro
zitangwa na Leta cyangwa abikorera
cyangwa izindi nyandiko zishobora
gucuruzwa.
(2) Imirimo iteganyijwe mu gika cya (1)
ntigomba gukorwa mu nyungu
z’isanduku ya Leta cyangwa mu
nyungu z’urwego rushyiraho
inyandiko z’agaciro.
(3) Ku mpamvu zijyanye na politiki
y’ifaranga, BNR ishobora kugura,
gutunga no kugurisha inyandiko
z’agaciro zishyirwa ku isoko na Leta
cyangwa inzego zayo. Icyakora, ubwo
bugure ntibukorwa mu rwego rwo
gutera inkunga icyuho cy’ingengo
y’imari ya Leta, kandi bukorerwa ku
isoko rya kabiri ku giciro cy’isoko.
(4) BNR ishobora kandi kugura no
kugurisha inyandiko zayo z’agaciro
zishobora gucuruzwa ku isoko.
UMUTWE WA V: IMIKORANIRE YA
BNR NA LETA, IZINDI NZEGO N’IBIGO
Icyiciro cya mbere: Imikoranire na Leta,
inzego za Leta n’inzego mpuzamahanga

articles.heading: Imicungire ya konti za Leta (1) BNR ikora imirimo yerekeranye no kubika no kubikuza amafaranga ya
articles.text:
Leta, kuguza no kwishyura imyenda
yayo. Icunga nta kiguzi mu bitabo
byayo, konti isanzwe y’isanduku ya
Leta hakurikijwe amasezerano igirana
na Minisiteri ifite imari mu nshingano.
(2) BNR ishobora gufungura izindi konti
za Leta zigengwa n’amategeko
yihariye, bisabwe na Minisitiri ufite
imari mu nshingano.
(3) Amafaranga ari kuri konti ziteganywa
muri iyi ngingo ntabyara inyungu.

articles.heading: Inyandiko nyemezamwenda za Leta z’imbere mu Gihugu BNR igira uruhare mu gushyiraho no gukwirakwiza inyandiko nyemezamwenda za
articles.text:
Leta z’imbere mu Gihugu ku nyungu za Leta,
hakurikijwe amasezerano igirana na Minisiteri
ifite imari mu nshingano.

articles.heading: Inguzanyo zihabwa Leta (1) BNR ntishobora guha Leta inguzanyo, keretse inguzanyo z’ingoboka z’ako
articles.text:
kanya mu gihe havutse icyuho hagati
y’amafaranga yinjira n’asohoka mu
Isanduku ya Leta kugira ngo ishobore
gukomeza gukora neza. Inguzanyo
z’ingoboka ntizishobora kurenga 11%
by’amafaranga Leta iba yinjije mu
mwaka w’ingengo y’imari ubanza.
(2) BNR ifata ku mwenda uvugwa mu
gika cya (1) inyungu zibarwa
hakurikijwe impuzandengo y’inyungu
banki z’ubucuruzi zigurizanyaho ku
munsi.
(3) Leta yishyura inguzanyo y’ingoboka
yagurijwe na BNR mu mwaka
w’ingengo y’imari yatanzwemo
ikoresheje amafaranga.

articles.heading: Imicungire ya konti zisanzwe z’izindi nzego (1) BNR ishobora gufungurira no gucungira konti zisanzwe ikigo cya
articles.text:
Leta cyangwa urwego rwa Leta, banki
nkuru y’ikindi gihugu, umuryango
mpuzamahanga cyangwa uhagarariye
igihugu cye mu Rwanda.
(2) Konti ziteganyijwe muri iyi ngingo
ntizishobora kugira umwenda kandi
amafaranga aziriho ntabyara inyungu.

articles.heading: Uruhare rwa BNR mu mikoranire ya Leta n’imiryango mpuzamahanga y’imari (1) BNR yunganira ubutegetsi bwite bwa
articles.text:
Leta mu mikoranire yabwo
n’imiryango mpuzamahanga y’imari
kandi ishobora kubuhagararira muri
iyo miryango no mu nama
mpuzamahanga.
(2) BNR ifatanyije n’ubutegetsi bwite bwa
Leta, ikurikirana kandi ishobora
guhagararira Leta mu mirimo yo
kwakira cyangwa gutanga inguzanyo
zo hanze y’Igihugu.
(3) BNR yunganira Leta mu kumvikana
ku masezerano mpuzamahanga yo
kwishyurana, kuvunjisha no guhuza
imyenda ikanayashyira mu bikorwa.

articles.heading: Amasezerano y’ubufatanye BNR igirana n’inzego zo mu mahanga bihuje inshingano BNR ishobora kugirana amasezerano
articles.text:
y’ubufatanye na banki nkuru y’ikindi gihugu,
inzego zo mu mahanga zishinzwe igenzura,
izishinzwe gushyiraho amabwiriza atunganya
amasoko y’imari yo mu bindi bihugu n’ibigo
by’imari mpuzamahanga.
Icyiciro cya 2: Imikoranire ya BNR n’ibigo
by’imari byo mu Rwanda

articles.heading: Imicungire ya konti z’ibigo by’imari
Ihwanyabwishyu BNR, ifatanyije n’ikigo cy’imari cyabiherewe uburenganzira, ishobora – (a) gutunganya uburyo
articles.text:
bw’ihwanyabwishyu kugira ngo
yoroshye ihwanyabwishyu
ry’inyandiko zo kwishyurana no
guhana imyenda;
(b) gushyiraho amabwiriza yihariye
arebana n’inyandiko zo
kwishyurana no guhana imyenda
ziteganywa mu gaka ka (a), uburyo
zikoreshwa, zikusanywa,
zishyurwa n’uko zitishyurwa,
akanagena imikorere y’ibindi bigo
bishinzwe isuzuma n’iyishyurana
BNR iha uburenganzira bwo
gukora isuzuma ry’iyishyurana;
(c) gushyiraho, igihe ibona ko ari
ngombwa, uburyo koranabuhanga
bwifashishwa mu myishyuranire
ijyanye n’amafaranga n’inyandiko
z’agaciro no kugira uruhare mu
myishyuranire ijyanye na byo
ikorwa hifashishijwe ubundi
buryo;
(d) no gushyiraho amabwiriza
n’amabwiriza yihariye ajyanye
n’uburyo bw’ihwanyabwishyu
n’ubw’imyishyuranire.

articles.heading: Amafaranga atagibwa munsi (1) BNR ishobora gusaba ikigo cy’imari guhorana igipimo kitagibwa munsi
articles.text:
cy’amafaranga igena, hashingiwe ku
mubare w’amafaranga yose abitswe
A
cyangwa imyenda y’ikigo cy’imari.
(2) Igipimo kitagibwa munsi
cy’amafaranga avugwa mu gika cya
(1) agizwe n’amafaranga ikigo
cy’imari bireba gihorana kandi akaba
ashobora no kubarirwamo inoti
n’ibiceri bibitswe mu mitamenwa
y’amabanki cyangwa y’ikigo cy’imari
cyakira amafaranga abitswa.
(3) Igipimo kitagibwa munsi
cy’amafaranga giteganywa mu gika
cya (1) ntigishobora gufatirwa, keretse
BNR ibigennye ukundi.

articles.heading: Itangwa ry’inguzanyo ku kigo cy’imari (1) BNR ishobora gutanga inguzanyo cyangwa inguzanyo z’ingoboka ku
articles.text:
kigo cy’imari, mu rwego rwo gukora
imirimo yayo yerekeye politiki
y’ifaranga n’ukutajegajega k’urwego
rw’imari gusa.
(2) Inguzanyo n’inguzanyo z’ingoboka
ziteganywa mu gika cya (1) zigomba
kuba zishingiwe n’ingwate ikwiye
yemejwe na BNR.
(3) BNR ishobora gutanga kandi ubufasha
bwo guhangana n’ibibazo
by’amafaranga buhabwa gusa ikigo
cy’imari gifite ubushobozi bwo
kwishyura ariko cyagize ikibazo cyo
kubura amafaranga by’igihe gito,
gitanze ingwate kandi amafaranga
yatanzweho ubufasha akishyurwa ku
nyungu iri hejuru kandi mu gihe kigufi.
(4) Amabwiriza yihariye agena igihe,
ingano y’inyungu n’ibindi bisabwa mu
itangwa ry’inguzanyo, inguzanyo
z’ingoboka n’ubufasha bwo
guhangana n’ibibazo by’amafaranga.
Icyiciro cya 3: Ibanga mu bikorwa bya BNR

articles.heading: Kugira ibanga (1) Ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi, umukozi wa BNR cyangwa undi wese umenye ibanga, haba mu gihe akora umurimo
articles.text:
we muri BNR na nyuma yo gusoza
umurimo muri BNR cyangwa mu
bundi buryo, agomba kugira ibanga.
(2) Kutubahiriza ibiteganywa mu gika cya
(1) bihanishwa ibihano biteganywa
n’amategeko abigenga.
(3) Abantu bateganywa mu gika cya (1)
ntibahanirwa kumena ibanga ry’akazi
iyo –
(a) gutanga amakuru y’ibanga
bikozwe mu rwego rwo kuzuza
inshingano z’akazi hubahirijwe
ibiteganywa n’iri tegeko;
(b) gutanga amakuru y’ibanga
bikozwe mu rwego rwo kubahiriza
amasezerano BNR yagiranye
n’ikindi kigo gishinzwe
ubugenzuzi gikwiye kuyahabwa;
(c) cyangwa gutanga amakuru
y’ibanga byategetswe n’icyemezo
cy’urukiko.
(4) BNR ishobora guha amakuru y’ibanga
urwego rw’ubutegetsi rwa Leta
n’urundi rwego rwose hakurikijwe
amategeko abigenga.

articles.heading: Ihererekanya ry’amakuru y’ibanga BNR ifite uburenganzira bwo guhanahana amakuru y’ibanga n’ikigo cyo mu mahanga
articles.text:
gikora imirimo nk’iyayo, banki yo mu kindi
gihugu, urwego rushinzwe ubugenzuzi,
urwego rwo mu mahanga rushinzwe
gushyiraho amabwiriza agenga imari cyangwa
ikigo mpuzamahanga, ishingiye ku nshingano
yo kubika ibanga izo nzego zihabwa amakuru
zifite.
UMUTWE WA VI: UMUTUNGO
N’IMARI

articles.heading: Umwaka w’ingengo y’imari, iyemezwa n’itangazwa by’imiterere ya konti (1) Umwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa BNR
articles.text:
utangira ku itariki ya 01 Nyakanga buri
mwaka ukarangira ku itariki ya 30
Kamena y’umwaka ukurikira.
(2) BNR yemeza imiterere ya konti zayo
ikanazitangaza mu Igazeti ya Leta ya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda nyuma ya buri
gihembwe.
(3) Ibaruramari rya BNR rikorwa
hubahirizwa ibipimo mpuzamahanga
ngenderwaho mu gutegura raporo
z’imari.

articles.heading: Ubugenzuzi bwite (1) Urwego rw’ubugenzuzi bwite bwa BNR rukora mu buryo bwigenga kandi bugamije gufasha BNR kugera ku
articles.text:
bigamijwe kugerwaho mu
igenamigambi ryayo, kurinda
umutungo wayo no kunoza imicungire
y’ibyateza ingorane, uburyo
bw’imikorere n’imiyoborere.
(2) Urwego rw’ubugenzuzi bwite bwa
BNR rutanga raporo mu buryo
bw’imikorere ku Nama y’Ubuyobozi
naho mu buryo bw’imiyoborere
rukayitanga ku Buyobozi.
(3) Urwego rw’ubugenzuzi bwite bwa
BNR rukurikiza amahame
mpuzamahanga ngenderwaho agenga
ubugenzuzi bwite.

articles.heading: Ubugenzuzi bwigenga (1) Ubugenzuzi bwigenga bukorwa n’umugenzuzi wigenga, ushyirwaho n’Inama y’Ubuyobozi
articles.text:
(2) Umugenzuzi wigenga afite inshingano
yo kugenzura no kwemeza konti za
buri mwaka w’ingengo y’imari za
BNR. Umugenzuzi wigenga akora
ubugenzuzi hubahirizwa amahame
mpuzamahanga ngenderwaho agenga
ubugenzuzi bw’imari.
(3) Umugenzuzi wigenga agenzura buri
mwaka raporo harimo –
(a) raporo y’uko imari ihagaze;
(b) raporo igaragaza ibyinjiye byose;
(c) raporo igaragaza ihinduka ry’imari
shingiro;
(d) na raporo y’uko inyungu
zisaranganywa.
(4) Umugenzuzi wigenga ashyikiriza
Inama y’Ubuyobozi raporo
y’ubugenzuzi bw’imari y’umwaka
w’ingengo y’imari urangiye mu
gihembwe cya mbere cy’umwaka
ukurikira.
(5) Umugenzuzi wigenga ashyirwaho mu
gihe cy’umwaka gishobora kongerwa.
Iyo akoze ubugenzuzi mu gihe
cy’imyaka itanu ikurikiranye,
ntiyemerewe kongera gushyirwaho
mbere y’imyaka itanu, ibarwa uhereye
ku gihe yasoreje umwaka wa nyuma
w’ubugenzuzi.

articles.heading: Itangazwa rya raporo y’imari BNR itangaza mu Igazeti ya Leta ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda raporo y’imari
articles.text:
n’imikoreshereze y’imari byemejwe
n’umugenzuzi wigenga, mu gihe cy’amezi
atandatu akurikira isozwa ry’umwaka
w’ingengo y’imari.

articles.heading: Raporo y’ibyakozwe mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari Mu gihe kitarenze amezi ane akurikira isozwa rya buri mwaka w’ingengo y’imari,
articles.text:
Guverineri ageza kuri Perezida wa Repubulika
no ku Nteko Ishinga Amategeko, Imitwe
yombi, raporo y’umwaka y’ibyakozwe,
harimo na raporo y’imari y’umwaka
w’ingengo y’imari.

articles.heading: Iyishyurwa ry’igihombo (1) BNR ishyiraho konti zihariye zo kubarura inyungu n’igihombo bitaragaragara bituruka ku
articles.text:
mihindagurikire y’ivunjisha
n’iy’ibiciro ku isoko ry’ivunjisha
ry’amadovize, zahabu, ibikoresho
by’imari n’indi mitungo.
(2) Iyo konti za BNR z’umwaka
zigaragaje igihombo, cyishyurwa
hakoreshejwe amafaranga y’ingoboka.
Iyo amafaranga y’ingoboka
adashobora kwishyura igihombo
cyose, BNR isaba Leta kwishyura igice
gisigaye binyuze mu kongera
umutungo.
(3) Nyuma y’amezi atandatu yakiriye
ubusabe bwo kongera umutungo, Leta
yohereza muri BNR amafaranga
akenewe mu buryo bw’amafaranga
cyangwa mu buryo bw’impapuro
z’agaciro zibyara inyungu, ku nyungu
igenwa n’isoko ry’imari kandi zifite
itariki ntarengwa yo kwishyurwa.

articles.heading: Inyungu zisaranganywa (1) Inyungu nyayo ya BNR ibarwa hakurikijwe ibipimo mpuzamahanga ngenderwaho mu gutegura raporo
articles.text:
z’imari.
(2) Inyungu n’igihombo bitaragaragara
bituruka ku madovize, kuri zahabu, ku
bikoresho by’imari no ku yindi
mitungo ntibigira uruhare mu kugena
inyungu zisaranganywa.
(3) Ku nyungu nyayo isaranganywa, 20%
ashyirwa mu mafaranga y’ingoboka
kugira ngo imari shingiro yiyongere
igere nibura ku ikigero cya 10%
cy’imyenda y’amafaranga ya BNR.
(4) Nyuma yo gukura ku nyungu nyayo
andi mafaranga Inama y’Ubuyobozi
ibona ko bikozwe mu buryo bukwiye,
inyungu isigaye ishobora
gusaranganywa ishyirwa mu Isanduku
ya Leta.

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’ibitabo by’imibare y’ibarurishamibare n’inyigo ku byerekeye ubukungu n’imari (1) BNR itangaza ibitabo birimo imibare
articles.text:
y’ibarurishamibare n’inyigo
byerekeranye n’ubukungu n’imari.
(2) BNR isaba ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi,
ikigo cya Leta, icy’abikorera cyangwa
umuntu ku giti cye, kuyigezaho
imibare n’amakuru ikeneye mu
isesengura ry’ibyerekeranye
n’imiterere y’ubukungu, ifaranga,
inguzanyo, kwishyurana n’amahanga
n’ibisabwa byerekeye imyenda yo mu
mahanga.
(3) Ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi cyangwa
umuntu ku giti cye basabwe na BNR
amakuru avugwa mu gika cya (2)
bagomba kuyatanga.
(4) BNR ishobora gushyiraho uburyo
bw’imikoranire itaziguye n’ibigo
n’amashyirahamwe by’abanyamwuga
bashobora kuyiha amakuru akenewe
mu gukora isesengura.
UMUTWE WA VII: AMAKOSA
N’IBIHANO BYO MU RWEGO
RW’UBUTEGETSI

articles.heading: Amakosa n’ibihano byo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi Amabwiriza agena amakosa n’ibihano byo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi bihabwa umuntu ku giti
articles.text:
cye cyangwa ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi
bitubahirije amabwiriza, amabwiriza yihariye
cyangwa ibyemezo bya BNR bifashwe mu
rwego rwo kubahiriza inshingano zayo.

articles.heading: Iyubahirizwa ry’amabwiriza, amabwiriza yihariye n’ibyemezo bya BNR Amabwiriza, amabwiriza yihariye n’ibyemezo
articles.text:
bya BNR byubahirizwa n’abo bireba. Ishyirwa
mu bikorwa ryabyo ntirishobora guhagarara
keretse habonetse urubanza rubigena ukundi
ruciwe burundu n’urukiko rubifitiye
ububasha.
UMUTWE WA VIII: INGINGO
ZINYURANYE

articles.heading: Gusonera imisoro n’amahoro BNR
Umutekano w’umutungo wa BNR Leta yishingira umutekano w’inyubako n’uw’undi mutungo bya BNR ikanayigenera
articles.text:
abashinzwe umutekano ikeneye bo kurinda
abimura amafaranga, inyandiko z’agaciro
cyangwa undi mutungo w’agaciro nta kiguzi.
Icyakora, BNR ishobora kwiyambaza izindi
nzobere mu by’umutekano iyo bibaye
ngombwa.

articles.heading: Manda y’abagize inzego z’ubuyobozi za BNR bari mu mirimo igihe iri tegeko ritangiriye gukurikizwa
articles.text:
Igihe cya manda y’abagize inzego
z’ubuyobozi za BNR bari mu mirimo igihe iri
tegeko ritangira gukurikizwa kibarwa uhereye
ku munsi bashyiriwe mu mirimo.
UMUTWE WA IX: INGINGO ZISOZA

articles.heading: Ingingo izigama ikanavanaho Uretse ingingo ya mbere y’Itegeko nº 48/2017 ryo ku wa 23/09/2017 rigenga Banki Nkuru
articles.text:
y’u Rwanda nk’uko ryahinduwe, ku bijyanye
n’ishyirwaho rya BNR, izindi ngingo zaryo
zose zivanyweho.

articles.heading: Ingingo y’ururimi Iri tegeko ryateguwe mu rurimi rw’Icyongereza, risuzumwa kandi ritorwa mu
articles.text: rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda.
